results.dataset: NHLBI Pooled Cohorts, U.S. (Bhatt et al. JAMA Intern Med 2026)
results.metric: COPD GOLD 1: predicted life expectancy at 65 relative to no COPD
results.notes: Published cohort: ADO layer at age 65 with a mid-grade FEV1 % predicted per GOLD stage (breathlessness averaged), as a ratio to the same model's population life expectancy; observed: published life expectancy at 65 by GOLD stage divided by that without COPD (the cohort is healthier than the U.S. population, so ratios are compared). n is the whole cohort; stage sizes are not given in the abstract.
